_readme: Consortium partners. 'logo' is a path inside /public. 'region' is used for grouping ('EU Member State' or 'Partner Country').

partners.name: National School of Business Management Ltd (NSBM Green University)
partners.description: National School of Business Management (NSBM Green University) serves as the Project Coordinator, leading overall project coordination (WP1), dissemination, exploitation & sustainability (WP6), and co-leading pilot implementation (WP4). NSBM brings proven experience in industry-aligned ICT education and large-scale student engagement.

partners.name: University of Bremen (Universitaet Bremen)
partners.description: University of Bremen leads WP2 (Curriculum & Learning Framework Development), WP3 (Capacity Building), and WP5 (Quality Assurance). Bremen brings internationally recognised expertise in dual-education models, work-integrated learning, ethical AI governance, green computing, and competence-based curriculum design.

partners.name: Novi Sad School of Business (Visoka poslovna skola strukovnih studija u Novom Sadu)
partners.description: Novi Sad School of Business co-leads quality assurance activities and hosts a key transnational review meeting. NSSB contributes expertise in institutional reform, sustainability integration, micro-credential frameworks, and HEI–industry collaboration.

partners.name: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (Guarantee) Ltd
partners.description: SLIIT co-leads WP4 pilots and contributes to WP2 curriculum co-design and WP3 capacity building. SLIIT is a leader in applied ICT education with long-standing industry partnerships, enabling strong internship reform and validation.

partners.name: University of Colombo (School of Computing - UCSC)
partners.description: University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC) co-leads WP4 pilot cohorts and supports WP2 curriculum co-design and WP3 capacity building, providing deep academic expertise and ensuring national coverage and alignment with Sri Lanka’s digital economy strategy.

partners.name: University of Peradeniya
partners.description: University of Peradeniya co-leads WP4 pilot cohorts and supports curriculum and capacity building activities, bringing proven experience in Erasmus+ CBHE curriculum development and international academic networks.

partners.name: Villa College (Villa Educational Services Pvt Ltd)
partners.description: Villa College co-leads WP4 pilots in island contexts and hosts the project finalization and closing meeting (WP6). Villa College focuses on sustainable digital development for tourism and climate resilience in small-island contexts.

partners.name: Royal University of Bhutan (College of Science and Technology - CST)
partners.description: Royal University of Bhutan (CST) co-leads WP4 pilots and hosts the dissemination and stakeholder engagement meeting (WP6), ensuring cultural and environmental alignment with Bhutan's Gross National Happiness framework and national green transition strategies.

partners.name: The Maldives National University (Dhivehi Raajjeyge Qaumee University)
partners.description: The Maldives National University co-leads WP4 pilots in island contexts and supports dissemination and sustainability, adapting project outputs to small-state higher education and national digital transformation priorities.

partners.name: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education (MOHE-SL)
partners.description: National government ministry in Sri Lanka supporting policy dialogue, mainstreaming of competence-based education, and institutional accreditation of project outcomes.

partners.name: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development
partners.description: National ministry in the Maldives supporting national digital transformation strategies, skills development, and policy uptake of internship and curriculum frameworks.

partners.name: Sri Lanka Section of BCS the Chartered Institute for IT
partners.description: Leading chartered professional body for IT in Sri Lanka, supporting industry alignment, skills standards, internship placements, and professional recognition.
